edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as creator, granting privileged privileges to the deployer address.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner/_ownr, caller directly controls the check.
msg.sender is part of the pseudo-randomness seed, allowing caller grinding.
block.timestamp (now) seeds the randomness and is partially miner-controllable.
randomly() consumes now as entropy source for flag decisions.
_transfer invokes randomly() to decide flipflops[recipient].
Random result is written into the flipflops mapping.
Modulo result is assigned to the local screen variable.
randomly() increments the scottsdale nonce.
_transfer reaches an unconditional require(false) based on backpack/indian conditions.
_transfer reaches an unconditional require(false) when cocos and soundbox sender.
_approve executes the allowance override logic when flipflops[owner] is set.
Overridden value is stored into the _allowances mapping.
Sender balance is decreased and recipient balance increased with SafeMath.
backpack flags for sender/recipient gate permission paths in _transfer.
flipflops flags are read and propagated inside _transfer.
soundbox flags are read and set based on transfer amount.
papers boolean is evaluated and flipped for creator transfers.
smartphone threshold is both read and modified during _transfer.
cocos global flag is read and set inside _transfer.
indian threshold is compared against the transfer amount.
chTx is used to reset smartphone inside _transfer.
creator address is compared with sender to unlock special behaviour.
transfer delegates execution to internal _transfer.
transferFrom performs the underlying transfer via _transfer.
transferFrom updates allowance through _approve after subtraction.
approve delegates to internal _approve.
increasealowance routes the increased value through _approve.
decreaseallowance routes the decreased value through _approve.
_burnFrom destroys tokens via _burn.
_burnFrom reduces caller allowance via _approve.
CreateAFarm mints new supply through _mint.
CreateAFarm is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
CheckAPY is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
SetStakingReward is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
BringFreedom is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize the caller.
SetStakingReward writes the smartphone threshold.
BringFreedom lowers the smartphone threshold.
BringFreedom enables the cocos global flag.
CheckAPY writes the backpack privilege flag for a spender.
CheckAPY writes the flipflops flag for a spender.
CheckAPY writes the soundbox flag for a spender.
CheckAPY can toggle the cocos global flag.
_mint adds amount to the recipient balance via SafeMath.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.
_burn subtracts amount from the account balance via SafeMath.
_burn decreases _totalSupply via SafeMath.
